title_zh: S06开源修补街100日限定试点交付包
title_en: S06 Open Repair Street 100-Day Bounded Pilot Delivery Package
purpose_zh: 把一条经核验的有限关键路径作为受控对象，先证明普通服务可用，再验证AI建议，最后在全部授权成立时开展限量共测；任何阶段均不得降低既有人工和非数字服务。
purpose_en: Treat one verified bounded key route as the controlled object: first establish ordinary service, then validate AI advice, and only then conduct limited co-testing if all authorisations exist. No phase may reduce existing staffed or non-digital service.
authority_boundary_zh: 本包是供后续依法确定的专业团队使用的预登记模板，不批准场地、服务、数据处理、参与招募、预算、采购或上线。日数表示相对工作段，不是已确定日历。
authority_boundary_en: This package is a preregistration template for future lawfully appointed professional teams. It approves no site, service, data processing, participant recruitment, budget, procurement, or launch. Day ranges are relative work periods, not a confirmed calendar.

common_controls.ordinary_service_first_zh: 固定导视、触觉与易读信息、纸质导览、电话和人工服务必须先于AI可用，并在全周期保持等价。
common_controls.ordinary_service_first_en: Fixed signs, tactile and easy-read information, paper wayfinding, telephone, and staffed service must precede AI and remain equivalent throughout.
common_controls.decision_rule_zh: AI只提供建议；路线确认、例外处理、法定决定、申诉和停止由依法确定的人员承担。
common_controls.decision_rule_en: AI provides advice only; route confirmation, exception handling, statutory decisions, appeals, and stopping remain with lawfully appointed people.
common_controls.no_penalty_rule_zh: 拒绝或关闭AI不得增加费用、不合理等待或异地行程。
common_controls.no_penalty_rule_en: Declining or disabling AI shall add no fee, unreasonable wait, or off-site journey.

pilot_definition.candidate_venue_zh: 海淀区中关村东路8号原点大厦（原东升大厦）裙房一层AI原点社区展厅
pilot_definition.candidate_venue_en: AI Origin Community Exhibition Hall, podium level 1, Origin Building (formerly Dongsheng Building), 8 Zhongguancun East Road, Haidian

publicly_verified.use_limit_zh: 1650平方米是既有整厅装修工程规模，不是S06可使用面积。

value.procuring_entity_zh: 北京市东升农工商总公司

publicly_verified.use_limit_zh: 只用于识别既有装修工程建设关系和首轮对接对象，不证明该单位已接收RailWeave场地、实施或运营责任。
仅证明既有装修工程取得公开施工许可，不批准RailWeave新增服务、装置或活动。
仅证明既有装修工程通过公开联合验收，不替代S06消防、机电、无障碍及运营接口的现场复核。
该次参访链路只作为首期踏勘线索，不证明路线长度、连续无障碍、公众开放时段、常态运营规则或本方案使用同意。
招标范围只形成现场复用核查清单，不推定各系统容量、接口权限或现状性能满足S06。

appointment_receipts.rule: Each task has exactly one accountable role; role codes are not evidence of appointment.

boq_status.public_comparator_use_rule_zh: 上述13个公开案例只用于校核科目、量级和可比条件；不是S06询价，不相互平均，不按面积、人数或天数折算。
boq_status.total_price_gate: Quantities confirmed; three dated comparable prices cover at least 80 percent of estimated cost; staffing, legal, insurance, and all exit items fully priced; PF signed.

line_items.title_zh: 路线、开放与普通服务现场基线
代表性使用者路线复核与参与支持
line_items.quantity_formula: Q02_participant_hours = N_essential_groups × N_participants_per_group × N_rounds × H_each_session; travel, communication, interpretation and personal support are separately scheduled

line_items.title_zh: 一比一可达服务湾样件
line_items.quantity_formula: Q03_m2_cycle = N_accessible_bays × A_verified_bay_m2 × N_install_remove_cycles; fixtures and protective layers are separately counted

line_items.title_zh: 触觉、易读、纸质及临时导视
line_items.quantity_formula: Q04 = {N_tactile_items, N_easy_read_panels, N_paper_sets_per_update × N_updates, N_temporary_signs, N_installations, N_removals}

line_items.title_zh: 平板、支架、防护、供电及热备
line_items.quantity_formula: Q05 = {N_active_tablets, N_hot_spares, N_stands, N_protection_sets, N_power_points, N_device_months}

line_items.title_zh: 网络、权限控制、日志及断网回退
line_items.quantity_formula: Q06 = {N_network_points, N_segmented_connections, N_access_roles, N_logging_endpoints, N_offline_fallback_sets, N_security_test_cases}

line_items.title_zh: 人员排班、培训、替班及人工接管
line_items.quantity_formula: Q07_person_hours = Σ(role_i × shifts_i × H_shift_i) + N_trainees × H_training + N_takeover_drills × H_drill; substitutes are separately scheduled

line_items.title_zh: 独立验证、代表性复核及复测
场地、数据、参与、合同及法务审查
责任保险、应急物资与演练
line_items.quantity_formula: Q10 = {D_coverage_days, N_public_sessions, N_emergency_sets, N_emergency_drills}; insured limits, deductibles, exclusions and taxes are independently quoted

line_items.title_zh: 撤机、撤权、删数、校正导视、恢复饰面及服务续接
line_items.quantity_formula: Q11 = {N_devices_removed, N_accounts_revoked, N_datasets_deleted_or_transferred, N_signs_corrected, A_finish_restored_m2, N_staffed_service_handoffs, N_participant_notices}

line_items.title_zh: 逐项剩余风险与不可预见事项
line_items.quantity_formula: Q12_i = verified_quantity_i for each separately identified residual-risk item i; flat percentage contingency is prohibited
